_comment: Single source of truth for the build matrix. Each entry pins the exact php.net tarball (sha256) and the Fil-C patch that applies to it. Add a version: drop patches/php-<ver>-filc.patch, add an entry, bump. status: supported = builds+smoke-tests; port = patch needs manual hunks; unsupported = Fil-C port does not exist for this line.
